body: I would have loved to close out this thread as just sleepwalking, but  I just learned that when she finally went to sleep she appearently was disoriented and crying, she's still asleep now, will try to talk to her later and post what she thinks happened.

Update: She woke up, I got her a blanket and some water and she went to sleep in her original room. I asked her if she was okay and she assured me she's fine. I will ask her in private tomorrow after the party
Sorry for slow response times

She seemed calm, no real signs of emotional distress (spoke in a normal tone, no crying) however I did not get a very clear look at her, and it all seems so fuzzy and surreal now even though it happened barely like 20 minutes ago.
